sentences.text: Subhadeep Charkarborty & Ors vs Unknown on 4 March, 2025

Author: Suvra Ghosh Bench: Suvra Ghosh  220 04-03-2025 Ct. No.34 b.das CRR No. 4881 of 2024 In the matter of : Subhadeep Charkarborty & Ors.
...petitioners.
Ms. Ameena Kabir Mr. Nirmalya Dutta ...for the petitioners.

The petitioners who are the husband and parents in law of the private opposite party seek quashing of GR Case No.1309 of 2024 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Purba Bardhaman, presently committed to the learned Fast Track, 2nd Court, Purba Bardhaman on the ground that they have been falsely implicated.
The statements recorded under Section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure during investigation do not corroborate the version of the private opposite party in the FIR.
Injury report also does not support the prosecution case.

The private opposite party lodged a complaint under Section 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code against the petitioners earlier wherein the petitioners were acquitted vide judgment delivered on 20th February, 2021 by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Purba Bardhaman in GR Case No.2207 of 2020.
Upon perusal of the material on record this Court is of the view that the matter needs to be heard on merits.
The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let the matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of May, 2025.

Further proceedings of GR Case No.1309 of 2024 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Purba Bardhaman, presently committed to the learned Fast Track, 2nd Court, Purba Bardhaman be stayed till 20th May, 2025 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
Urgent certified website copy of the order, if applied for, be given to the parties on compliance of requisite formalities.
